# Kit Carrow

## Appearance

Kit possesses a particularly pleasing appearance, featuring hazel eyes and a steady, humorous mouth inherited from his father. From his mother, he has curling red hair and a fine nose.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P21](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0021)_

## Personality

Kit Carrow is a dependable and solid individual, widely regarded as the squarest boy in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes), who nevertheless takes great joy in a periodic brawl and is a skilled combatant. He harbors a deep fondness for [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), possesses a talent for imitating the calls of any wild bird or animal in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), and spends his evenings preparing for an entrance examination. Passionate about military life, he strongly desires to serve as a soldier and become a famous, victorious general.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P25](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0025), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P22](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P66](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0066), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), +1 more_

## History

Kit Carrow grew up as part of the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) family at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where he and his siblings quickly became fast friends with the Ashdown children from the manse. Seeking to prevent gossip from shaming the local minister after warnings from [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), Kit suggested that the children form a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to regulate their behavior. Later, the neighborhood children gathered outdoors to spend time together on Kit's final night before he departed for Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P33](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0033), +6 more_

## Quotes

> “Why do you not elevate yourselves?” Kit proposed. “I will offer a suggestion for what you should do. Establish a Good-Conduct Club and penalize yourselves whenever you commit an action that is improper.”
>
> — Kit Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054)

> “Oh, how I desire the return of the past,” Kit cried out. “It would be wonderful to serve as a soldier—to be a famous, victorious general. For the chance to witness a grand battle, I would sacrifice all I possess.”
>
> — Kit Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)

> “May the Piper arrive and be welcomed,” he exclaimed, making a gesture with his hand. “With joy, I will pursue him all over the earth.”
>
> — Kit Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P20](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0020)

> "Mary Stubbs, do not let me see you make Ida cry. What is it you are talking about?"
>
> — Kit Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P7](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0007)

> "we have to get to the bottom of this. A blunder has been made by someone. Grace, Sunday had good weather. What made you think Saturday was Sunday?"
>
> — Kit Carrow — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P21](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Grace](../character/grace.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grace--kit-carrow.md)

Kit and [Grace](../character/grace.md) are devoted companions and confederates who share a close bond among the local children. When [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) scolds the manse children regarding their misbehavior and local gossip, Kit arrives to propose a solution. He suggests they form a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to manage their behavior and protect their father's reputation, an idea [Grace](../character/grace.md) and her siblings readily adopt.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P33](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0033), +2 more_

- Comrade of — devoted companions and confederates  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045)</sub>

### [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/kit-carrow--mary-stubbs.md)

Kit maintains a friendly relationship with [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md), who acts as a favoured companion among the local children. After Mary confronts the manse children in the graveyard over local rumors and their misbehavior, Kit steps in to offer a constructive way forward for the group. His suggestion to create a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) directly addresses the concerns and warnings Mary raises regarding their father's reputation.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P29](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0029), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P33](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0033), +5 more_

- Friend of — favoured companion  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P29](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0029)</sub>
